name: io.github.liyooh007/bazi-chart
title: bazi-chart
description: Four Pillars of Destiny (BaZi) chart engine for the Chinese calendar: VSOP87D solar terms validated against JPL DE441 (<=1 min), true-solar-time with automatic cross-midnight pillar correction, lunar conversion, patterns/useful-god, shensha and major/annual/monthly luck. Pure Python standard library, fully offline; returns deterministic chart facts only.
